fullTextEN: Teacher Wang is here again!
How have you all been recently?

fullTextZH: 今天我要继续给你们讲孙悟空的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I will continue to tell you the story of Sun Wukong.

fullTextZH: 上次的故事你们还记得吗？
fullTextEN: Do you still remember the last story?

fullTextZH: 孙悟空变成了老爷爷的女儿，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong turned into the old man's daughter,
to help the old man fight the monster.

fullTextZH: 妖怪背着变成女儿的孙悟空爬山，
fullTextEN: The monster carried Sun Wukong, who turned into a daughter, up the mountain,
Climbing and climbing,
The more the monster climbed, the more tired it got!
They rested under a tree.

fullTextZH: 妖怪把自己的故事告诉了孙悟空：
fullTextEN: The monster told its story to Sun Wukong:

fullTextZH: 原来这个妖怪以前也是神仙，
fullTextEN: It turns out this monster was also an immortal before,

fullTextZH: 在一次派对上喝了太多酒，
fullTextEN: drank too much at a party once,
did something wrong,
and then turned into a monster.

fullTextZH: 这个时候，孙悟空变回了自己的样子！
fullTextEN: At this moment, Sun Wukong turned back into his own form!
The monster saw it was Sun Wukong,
and was extremely scared,
and ran very fast!

fullTextZH: 孙悟空坐着筋斗云，一下就追上了他。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong sat on the somersault cloud and quickly caught up with him.
They kept fighting and fighting,
fought for a long time.
The monster was exhausted,

fullTextZH: 妖怪对孙悟空说：“猴子爷爷，
fullTextEN: The monster said to Sun Wukong: "Monkey Grandpa,
I was wrong! I was wrong!
Stop hitting, don't hit me anymore,
and you can't hit me!

fullTextZH: 观音让我在这等一个人，
fullTextEN: Guanyin told me to wait here for someone,
This person is called Tang Seng,
he is going to Tathagata's place to get scriptures.
Guanyin told me to be his disciple,

fullTextZH: 陪他一起去如来家拿书！”
fullTextEN: to accompany him to Tathagata's place to get scriptures!"
Sun Wukong listened and said:

fullTextZH: “观音也让你做唐僧的徒弟吗？
fullTextEN: "Did Guanyin also tell you to be Tang Seng's disciple?
A few months ago,

fullTextZH: 观音也让我做了唐僧的第一个徒弟，
fullTextEN: Guanyin also told me to be Tang Seng's first disciple,
so you are the second disciple!
Let's go, I'll take you to see the master!"
The two of them sat on a cloud,
preparing to return to the old man's house.
The sky is already bright,
The sun has come out.

fullTextZH: 唐僧和老爷爷一家人等得非常着急！
fullTextEN: Tang Seng and the old man's family are very anxious!
At this time,

fullTextZH: 他们看见天上孙悟空带着妖怪回来了！
fullTextEN: They saw Sun Wukong returning with the monster in the sky!

fullTextZH: 唐僧让他给老爷爷说对不起，
fullTextEN: Tang Seng asked him to apologize to the old man,
The monster was very obedient,

fullTextZH: 他对老爷爷说了对不起。
fullTextEN: He apologized to the old man.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空说：“快点快点，叫师傅！”
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong said: 'Hurry up, call Master!'
Tang Seng was very puzzled after hearing this:
'How can you call him Master?'
Sun Wukong told him:

fullTextZH: “观音也让这个妖怪做了他的徒弟，
fullTextEN: 'Guanyin also made this monster his disciple,
to protect him on the journey to get the scriptures from Tathagata!'

fullTextZH: 这个时候，猪八戒高兴了：
fullTextEN: At this time, Zhu Bajie was happy:
'Having met the Master,

fullTextZH: 我现在可以喝酒吃肉了！”
fullTextEN: I can now drink and eat meat!'
Tang Seng said: 'No, you can't!

fullTextZH: 不可以，出家的人不能这样！”
fullTextEN: No, monks can't do that!'
'Monks cannot eat the five pungent spices and three forbidden meats,'

fullTextZH: 就是有八种东西不能吃，
fullTextEN: There are eight types of things that cannot be eaten,

fullTextZH: 葱、蒜、韭菜、薤、兴渠、狗肉、雁肉和乌鱼！”
fullTextEN: Green onions, garlic, chives, shallots, xingqu, dog meat, goose meat, and black fish!
How about this,
I'll give you a name,
You will be called Bajie!
Starting today,

fullTextZH: 我们就不能再叫他妖怪了，
fullTextEN: we can no longer call him a monster,
he also has his own name now,
he is called Zhu Bajie!

fullTextZH: 老爷爷看到唐僧又多了一个徒弟，
fullTextEN: The old man saw that Tang Monk had another disciple,
and was very happy,

fullTextZH: 他让人拿来了黄金和白银做的元宝。
fullTextEN: He had people bring gold and silver ingots.
What are ingots?
They are ancient money!

fullTextZH: 老爷爷让人把元宝放在唐僧面前，
fullTextEN: The old man had people place the ingots in front of Tang Monk,
Tang Monk waved his hand and said, "No way!

fullTextZH: 不可以，出家的人不能要这些金银！”
fullTextEN: No way, monks cannot accept these gold and silver!"
"We are leaving now,
thank you, old man!"

fullTextZH: 这个时候，猪八戒着急了：
fullTextEN: At this moment, Zhu Bajie became anxious:
"Master! Master!
Look at my clothes—

fullTextZH: 昨天晚上背着孙悟空爬山，
fullTextEN: Last night I carried Sun Wukong up the mountain,
and got beaten by him again,
my clothes are all torn!"

fullTextZH: 老爷爷笑着拿来了一件衣服，
fullTextEN: The old man smiled and brought a piece of clothing,
and gave it to Zhu Bajie.
Zhu Bajie put on the new clothes,
and was very happy,
smiling, he said to Tang Monk: "Master,
Master, we can't take gold and silver,
nor can we eat meat and wine,
but can we have a piece of clothing?"
Tang Monk laughed,
their master,

fullTextZH: 徒弟三个人高高兴兴地出发了！
fullTextEN: and the three disciples set off happily!

fullTextZH: 后来又会发生什么事情呢？
fullTextEN: What will happen next?

fullTextZH: 下次王老师会告诉你哦，再见啦！
fullTextEN: Next time, Teacher Wang will tell you, goodbye!
